title: Differentiability and Convexity of the Solution Maps for Fully Non-linear Parabolic HJB Equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.35476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the dependence on the terminal condition of solutions to a fully nonlinear parabolic Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equation, when the terminal condition varies along a finite-dimensional family. This problem is motivated by a dual formulation of semimartingale optimal transport. The equation is posed as a terminal-value Cauchy problem on an unbounded spatial domain. Under structural ellipticity and regularity assumptions on the nonlinear operator, we recall local parabolic H\"older estimates and stability results for bounded uniformly continuous terminal data. We then establish continuous directional differentiability of the solution map with respect to the finite-dimensional parameter, and identify its derivative through the corresponding linearized Cauchy problem. translated_title: 全非线性抛物型HJB方程解映射的可微性与凸性
translated_abstract: 我们研究全非线性抛物型哈密顿–雅可比–贝尔曼（HJB）方程的解对终端条件的依赖性，其中终端条件沿一个有限维族变化。该问题的动机来自半鞅最优传输的对偶表述。方程被表述为无界空间区域上的终端值柯西问题。在对非线性算子的结构性椭圆性与正则性假设下，我们回顾了针对有界一致连续终端数据的局部抛物型Hölder估计与稳定性结果。随后，我们建立了解映射关于有限维参数的连续方向可微性，并通过相应的线性化柯西问题刻画其导数。在哈密顿函数的额外凸性假设与终端数据的非退化条件下，我们证明了点值（评估）映射的局部强凸性。
tldr: 该论文证明了全非线性抛物型HJB方程的解映射关于终端条件的有限维参数具有连续方向可微性（其导数由线性化柯西问题刻画），并在哈密顿量凸性与终端数据非退化条件下证明了点值映射的局部强凸性，从而为半鞅最优传输的对偶表述提供了理论支撑。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes continuous directional differentiability of the solution map for a fully nonlinear parabolic HJB equation with respect to finite-dimensional perturbations of the terminal condition—identifying the derivative via the corresponding linearized Cauchy problem—and proves local strong convexity of the point-evaluation map under convexity and non-degeneracy assumptions, motivated by duality in semimartingale optimal transport.
